excluded_model_families.note: Hybrid-attention, VL and MoE checkpoints are out of dense scope and must fail closed.

business_blind.note: Dense qwen3_4b/8b/14b safe-admission rate 1.0, OOM-admission rate 0.0, memory MAPE 11.4% over 46 LoRA jobs (packing on/off, ZeRO none/2/3, 1-2 GPU, cutoff 2048/4096).

transfer_validation.note: 24/24 dense success (full+lora, qwen3_1p7b/4b/8b/14b/32b, ZeRO none/2/3, 1/2/4 GPU, cutoff 1024/4096/8192/16384). No selected OOM; memory upper never falsely admitted an OOM.

engineering_assumption: The business blind and transfer-validation evidence jointly cover dense Qwen full-attention scales qwen3_1p7b/4b/8b/14b/32b, Full/LoRA, packing on/off, ZeRO none/2/3 and 1/2/4 GPUs. Per explicit user acceptance the release scope is aligned with the pure-text Packing production release rather than restricted to the exact measured tuples; production admission treats the listed axes as transferable and fails closed outside them.
known_limitation: Neither evidence source contains any OOM boundary sample (business blind is 46/46 success, transfer validation is 24/24 success). Admission therefore has no false-safe counter-evidence and relies entirely on the unified V3 memory upper staying below the safe limit with fail-closed behaviour. Grid cells absent from both sources (for example cutoff_len 512 and target_gbs 32/128/256) are admitted only through the unified V3 upper, not through direct measurement. Hybrid-attention (qwen3p5_*/qwen3_6_*), VL and MoE requests are always out of scope and fail closed.
rollback: Set status to disabled or automatic_execution_allowed to false; the request then falls back to non-automatic memory recommendation.
